_comment: Synthetic Phase β receipt example for /api/anchor-receipt.schema.v1.json with anchor.method == 'phase_beta_sc_inscribe'. This file is NOT a snapshot of any production inscription — all hex strings, tx_ids, block numbers, and timestamps are synthetic placeholders. Demonstrates the Phase β shape (= metalfreedom::inscribe smart-contract action) where the inscribe_action carries `data` (six structured fields per scripts/operator-local/contract/metalfreedom-anchor.spec.md §2.1) and `authorization` (Antelope action.authorization array) instead of the Phase α `from`/`to`/`quantity`/`memo`/`permission` shape. Phase β does NOT use eosio.token::transfer; the from/to/quantity/memo fields are omitted. See /api/anchor-receipt.example.json for the Phase α shape.
